Total revenue per month (2026): Jan 6,440 | Feb 2,237 | Mar 4,187 | Apr 2,726 | May 14,612 | Jun 10,022 (59 rows used).

Problems found and fixes applied:
1. Invalid dates — rows 24, 39, 55 held impossible dates (2026-14-01, 2026-02-30). Set to missing (approved), so they cannot be assigned to a month and are excluded from the monthly totals.
2. Exact duplicate rows — rows 12 and 51 were copies of earlier rows; dropped (approved) to avoid double-counting revenue.
3. Revenue formula break — row 28 had Revenue 1055 vs Quantity*Price = 105; recomputed to 105 per the rules file (approved).
4. Category label variant — row 58 "office supplies" merged into "Office Supplies" (auto-approved). Does not affect revenue totals.

Caveats: the 3 rows with unreadable dates are omitted from the monthly breakdown (their revenue is not in any month). Region has 2 missing values and two misspellings ("Suoth", "Eats"), but Region is not used by this question, so it was left untouched. Columns used by the question (Date, Revenue, Quantity, Price) are otherwise clean.
